description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings for WRITING a Word .docx — create from content, fill a supplied template, surgical body-XML edit. Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours (docx→Markdown reading, PDF authoring, spreadsheets, slide decks, prose co-authoring) whose vocabulary overlaps.

queries.q: generate a .docx report from this content
fill this Word template with these values and save a copy
edit the heading and one table cell inside this existing .docx
erzeuge daraus ein Word-Dokument mit A4-Seitenformat und einer Tabelle
produce the contract as a Word file, not a PDF
extract the text of this .docx into Markdown so I can read it here
queries.note: reading a docx into the conversation, not writing one → markitdown

queries.q: merge these PDFs and fill the PDF form fields
queries.note: PDF authoring surface, different library-per-task path → pdf-tools

queries.q: build me a budget model with formulas in a spreadsheet
queries.note: spreadsheet/model authoring, not an OOXML text document → spreadsheet-authoring

queries.q: turn this into a slide deck for the pitch tomorrow
queries.note: presentation surface; pptx is gated, decks go to → html-deck

queries.q: help me write the PRD itself — structure the sections and stress-test the reader test
queries.note: authoring the prose/content of a spec, not producing the .docx container → doc-coauthoring
